source_refs.note: X-linked Dominant Traits: a main subheading of 18.8.1 Sex-linked Traits in Humans, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 107-108.

blocks.text: Yeh khasiyatein auraton mein mardon se zyada (taqreeban do guna) aam hain. Misalein: vitamin D-resistant rickets (vitamin D ko theek se istemal na kar pana, jis se haddiyan naram aur kamzor ho jati hain), Rett syndrome (dimagh ki nashonuma ki bimari jis mein bolna khatam ho jata hai, haath baar baar aik hi harkat karte hain aur chalne mein mushkil hoti hai) aur Aicardi syndrome (dimagh ki ghair maamooli nashonuma).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke X-linked dominant khasiyatein auraton aur mardon mein barabar nisbat mein hoti hain. Yeh sahi nahi: aurat ke do X hain, is liye allele rakhne ke do mauqe, aur yeh khasiyatein auraton mein zyada aam hain. Kitab ka agla nukta bhi yahi dikhata hai: mutasir baap ki sab betiyan mutasir hoti hain aur koi beta nahi.

blocks.alt: Insani shaklein. Khasiyat wali maa XRXr aur non-carrier baap XrY. Eggs XR aur Xr; sperm Xr aur Y. Lakeerein chaar bachchon tak: betiyan XRXr (khasiyat maujood) aur XrXr (non-carrier); bete XRY (khasiyat maujood) aur XrY (non-carrier). Key: R X-linked dominant allele, r X-linked recessive allele.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.16: X-linked dominant khasiyaton ki virasat (kitab ki Figure 18.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agar X-linked dominant khasiyat maa mein ho aur maa heterozygous ho to us ke 50% bachche ise le sakte hain; agar maa homozygous ho to sab bachche lete hain. Agar baap mein ho to us ki sab betiyan ise leti hain (beti ko baap ka X milta hai) aur koi beta nahi leta (bete ko baap ka X nahi milta).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne likha hai ke X-linked dominant khasiyat wali maa '(homozygous ya heterozygous)' ho to 50% bachche ise le sakte hain. 50% sirf heterozygous maa par sahi hai; homozygous maa har bachche ko dominant allele deti hai, is liye us ke sab bachche mutasir hote hain.
